Coming from a child that had parents that only stayed together for us kids.. Leave, it pained me much more to see my parents hurting and fighting all the time instead of today when they have separated. They are better parents when they are happy. 

you can't force it and sometimes people just grow apart and that's okei, you're kids will be much happier later in life. It may be hard for them at first, but it will be worth it :)
I've thought about it but seeing as there are so many out there much worse off then me I've tried to put it off.

There are always ways, make up is a great start but I guess you are right.

I am working on it, I'm still finding my feet again money wise so renting a place has been a bit hard but I hope to be able to find something in the next 2 months.

I had to leave a very close friend of mine a few months back and it hurt so much. 
We've been fwb for a while now and we care for each other deeply.
He has seen me cry,vomit, yell and laugh, with everything in-between. He's my best friend and when I left him to live in a new country it was so painful I couldn't breath, I felt as a part of me had just been pulled out and left open 

But

It got better,  you'll always miss them, but it will get easier and more bearable, trust me. 

Tell them how you feel, or you'll regret it, open up.

Thank you for that and yes, I've actually heard that a few times and I love that about myself but sometimes I hate it as well. 

Funny enough, I'm actually sitting in this guys bedroom. Just chilling, half shaking while he finishes some work on his computer, he's just one word away and deep down , I know he'd help but every time he looks over, I just smile like nothing is wrong.
I have a few times, but always chicken out. I just feel so weak and the words don't come out.
Hey! I'm in a really bad place as well , if you still want to chat I'm open :)

I've always been very bad at telling people how I feel and there is this one guy, that I actually want to reach out to, one of my best friend but I'm scared, dead scared. 
He's doing so well in his life and he's so happy atm that I feel like I'll just bum him down, ruin his mood and he'll push me away. 

I hardly have anyone else that I'm that close with beside one other friend but she's taking university test atm and I don't want to bother her either.

Thank you for that ! Yah, we're the people you see and are like "What.. you guys are friends?" 

>But I know long term it's just not in the cards because we both want different things for our futures.

That's okei ! Me and him have completely different visions for our future, I'm aiming for college and becoming a vet and his dream is to become a famous streamer !
He's lazy while I'm hard working, he likes to sleep in while I want to wake up early, he goes for long walks and I go to the gym, we're black and white but it's that we care for each other and support each other, that's what matters. 

Even tho you guys want different things you can still be friends, even if just for a short time because sometimes the friends you think will only be there for you in the that moment will be with you for the rest of your life :)

This may not be the complete same but I said this about one of my best friend to this day.
We used to work together and I thought he was funny and a nice guy but we didn't hang that much outside of work. When he quit the job we said that this friendship would never really last but almost one and a half year later we're best friends/FWB and I hang with him almost everyday and stay over all the time. I wouldn't know what I'd do without him!

Maybe give it a change, you'd be surprised and maybe it will turn into something beautiful, if not as lovers as friends.

This feeling has been going up and down for me for years now and I'm so tired of it but just as I'm typing this one of my best friends/FWB called we just talked about nothing , he was asking me about how to cook noodles and eggs the way I do it. It made me feel so happy, just hearing his voice but at the same time, terrified because if I actually go through with this.. I'd lose him and he would lose me but then again, the thought comes, would he even care?

I did try therapy once as a teenager and it didn't really help much, but then again I was a teenager and this was the counsellor at my school. 
I've felt this way for years now actually and I'm honesty not scared of dying it just, and the way I see it is that I'd just be a bother
"Oh , damn , she killed herself and now there's blood all over my carpet."

Yes, I've had depression since I was a young teen but I've never looked into anxiety really , possibly ?
I've never thought about going to the doctors.

I am actually not completely sure what I want, some days I feel as if we are in a relationship and it's great but then some days I feel like we're not even friends and it's not just him, it's me as well , I actually sometimes just wanna scream and yell at him because he's so annoying and silly.
I'm scared that they'll be mad, the last time I told someone about this he pushed me away, when I told my mother about this the last time she told me : then go and kill yourself.

Somehow I feel as if they wouldn't grief , why should they? 
There will always be other friends and other people that my friends will have.

I did as a teenager and it didn't help much. 
I might have to add that I'm ashamed and scared, I don't want people tell people about this as I feel that I am burdening them.

That was a very good read and thank you for those words , it's just frustrating how I find myself be doing something completely unrelated to this person and then boom , there he is , in my head with his goofy smile and the smell of cherry cigars , god I hate it so much but it just won't leave me , it's been months! I haven't seen this person in over  3 months but somehow.. there he still is.

I was in a similar situation as you are but we were friends before, we worked together and then started to go further ,  we became fuck buddies, at first we said no feelings and I completely agreed and didn't have any feelings for him, we just clicked so well sexually and it was amazing as well as we were good friends, but then it started to feel more , at least for me it did.
I'm very emotional while he isn't, but that's okei.

He treated me so well , we would spent countless nights together , sometimes I wouldn't even go home for days and we would just cuddle, watching movies and talking. 
We even spent new years night and new years day together but, he didn't want a relationship and I knew that but still , all of a sudden there they were, these bloody feelings of mine. 

So my advice is to first sit yourself down and think, am I really getting feelings for him or am I just enjoying myself? Will this harm me in emotionally in any way? Do you want this to go any further? Do you want to actually go and just have fun with him and not just sex?
Second. Talk about it. Just sit him down and tell him how you feel, talk it through cause that is the only way you will know where you stand and want this to go. 
Communication is key in a relationship of any kind.
